title: FATHER GOD, STAND IN THE GAP FOR ME AND MY HOUSEHOLD
text: I want you to take your time and share this prayer with someone. Don't just keep it to yourself. There is somebody in your family, there is somebody in your circle, there is somebody God has connected to your life that needs to hear this word tonight. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes that two are better than one and a threefold cord is not quickly broken. When you share the word of God, you are not just being a blessing, you are positioning yourself for divine acceleration. So, before we go into this prayer, I want you to share it. Share it on your status, send it to that uncle, send it to that aunt, send it to that brother, send it to that sister who is going through warfare right now. Someone needs to hear that God can stand in the gap. Can I hear a resounding amen? Now, I want us to go into the place of deep revelation tonight. I'm not here to give you entertainment, I'm not here to give you motivational speeches. I'm here to deliver the oracles of God concerning the subject of divine intervention and the ministry of intercession that God himself performs on behalf of his people. When we say God stand in the gap for me and my household, we are not speaking from a place of ignorance, we are speaking from a place of covenant understanding. We are speaking from a place of knowing that there is a gap, there is a breach, there is a place where the enemy seeks to enter and we are invoking the God who specializes in standing where we cannot stand. You see, the Bible gives us a very powerful revelation in the book of Ezekiel chapter 22 from verse 30. The Lord said, "I sought for a man among them who would make a wall and stand in the gap before me on behalf of the land that I should not destroy it, but I found no one." Now, this is a very sobering scripture because God was looking for an intercessor. God was looking for someone who would stand in that place of prayer, someone who would build up the hedge, someone who would close the breach, and the Bible says he found no one. But I prophesy to someone tonight in the season that you have that God himself will become your intercessor. When men fail you, when your friends cannot pray for you, when your pastors are not available, when your prayer partners are sleeping, the Bible says in Romans 8:26, "The Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings that cannot be uttered." Let me break this down for you. There are battles that you cannot fight with your human strength. There are wars that are beyond your capacity. There are confrontations in the realm of the spirit where your faith, as genuine as it is, needs divine backing. And this is where the ministry of God standing in the gap becomes absolutely critical. When the Bible talks about standing in the gap, it is talking about standing in that vulnerable place, that place of exposure, that place where the enemy has found access and closing it. It is the language of warfare. It is the language of defense. It is the language of covenant protection. Now, let me show you something very powerful in the scriptures. In Isaiah 59:16, the Bible says, "He saw that there was no man and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore, his own arm brought salvation for him and his own righteousness, it sustained him." Did you see that? When God looked and found no human intercessor, his own arm brought salvation. That means God has an arm of intervention. God has an arm of deliverance. God has an arm that can reach into your situation when human help has failed. Some of you tonight, you have been looking for help from relatives, you have been looking for help from friends, you have been looking for help from influential people and they have all disappointed you. But I have come to announce to you that there is a God whose arm is not shortened that it cannot save and whose ear is not heavy that it cannot hear. When you pray "God stand in the gap for me and my household," you are activating a covenant principle. You are not begging, you are not negotiating, you are reminding God of his word. You are saying, "Father, your word declares that you are a wall of fire round about me and the glory in the midst of me. Your word declares that no weapon fashioned against me shall prosper. Your word declares that you will keep me in perfect peace when my mind is stayed on you. This is not presumption, this is covenant confidence. This is what the Bible calls bold access to the throne of grace. Let me take you deeper. The concept of standing in the gap is military language. In ancient warfare, when an enemy broke through the wall of a city, soldiers would rush to that breach to prevent the enemy from flooding in. That place of the breach, that place of the gap, was the most dangerous place on the battlefield. It required courage, it required strength, it required someone willing to lay down their life. And the Bible says God is looking for that person who will stand in the gap, but when he finds none, he himself stands there. Glory to God. Some of you, the gap in your life is financial. The enemy has created a breach in your finances where money comes in and disappears. You work hard, but you have nothing to show for it. There is a leak, there is a gap, there is a hole in your pocket like the Bible talks about in Haggai. You need God to stand in that financial gap. You need God to close that hole that the devourer has been using to steal your substance. And I prophesy tonight, from this moment, every gap in your finances is closed by the blood of Jesus. Every demonic access into your income is blocked in the mighty name of Jesus. For others, the gap is in your health. There is a persistent sickness, there is a hereditary disease, there is a medical condition that has defied solutions. Doctors have tried, medications have failed, and you are wondering, "Where is my help coming from?" I have come to tell you that your help comes from the Lord who made heaven and earth. The same God who stood in the gap for Hezekiah when the prophet said, "Set your house in order, you shall die and not live." And God added 15 years to his life. That same God is your God tonight. He is the God who stood in the gap for the woman with the issue of blood. He is the God who stood in the gap for blind Bartimaeus. He is the God who stood in the gap for the paralyzed man at the pool of Bethesda. And he will stand in the gap for you. Let me show you another powerful dimension. When we talk about my household, we are not just talking about the people who live in your house. In biblical terminology, household represents your lineage, your bloodline, your generational heritage. It includes your children, your children's children, your parents, your siblings, everyone connected to you by blood and covenant. So, when you pray "God stand in the gap for me and my household," you are asking God to intervene in every area of generational warfare affecting your family. You are asking God to break every generational curse. You are asking God to scatter every ancestral covenant that is working against your destiny. There are some battles you are fighting that did not start with you. They are generational battles. There are some limitations that did not originate from your personal mistakes. They are ancestral limitations. The Bible talks about the iniquity of the fathers being visited upon the children onto the third and fourth generation. This means that there are consequences of sins and covenants made by your forefathers that are still affecting you today, but I have good news for you tonight. The same Bible that talks about generational curses also talks about generational blessings. The same Bible that says iniquity can pass from generation to generation also says that mercy and faithfulness can extend to a thousand generations of those who love God and keep his commandments. When God stands in the gap for your household, he's not just addressing your personal issues, he's addressing foundational issues. He's going back to the root, he's dealing with the source. This is why deliverance is so powerful. This is why we cannot joke with the ministry of deliverance because when God delivers you, he's not just removing surface level demons, he's uprooting ancestral strongholds. He's breaking covenants made in the kingdom of darkness before you were born. He's severing evil soul ties. He's canceling satanic registrations. Now, let me give you a practical example from scripture. In the book of Exodus chapter 32, when the children of Israel sinned by making the golden calf, the anger of the Lord was kindled against them. God said to Moses, "Let me alone that my wrath may burn hot against them and I may consume them." But the Bible says Moses stood in the gap. Moses began to intercede. Moses began to remind God of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. And the Bible says the Lord relented from the harm which he said he would do to his people. Do you understand what happened there? Moses became the gap stander. Moses became the intercessor. Moses became the one who prevented judgment from falling on an entire nation. But here is the revelation I want you to catch. There are times when you cannot stand in the gap for yourself. There are times when you are too weak, too tired, too overwhelmed, too broken. There are times when your faith is shaken, when your prayers feel like they are bouncing off the ceiling, when you don't even know what to pray for. This is when you need God himself to stand in the gap for you. This is when you need the Holy Spirit to make intercession for you with groanings that cannot be uttered. This is when you need the advocacy of Jesus Christ, who the Bible says is seated at the right hand of the Father, ever living to make intercession for us. Can I tell you something powerful? Jesus is your gap stander. Right now, as you are reading this, as you are hearing this word, Jesus is standing in the gap for you at the right hand of the Father. The Bible says in Hebrews 7:25, "Therefore, he is also able to save to the uttermost those who come to God through him, since he always lives to make intercession for them." Did you hear that? He always lives to make intercession. Not sometimes. Not when he feels like it. Not when you deserve it. Always. Every single moment of your life, Jesus is interceding for you. Every second, Jesus is standing in the gap between you and the judgment you deserve. Jesus is standing in the gap between you and the attacks of the enemy. Jesus is standing in the gap between you and the consequences of your mistakes. This is why the enemy hates you so much, because you are not just protected by your own prayers. You are backed by the intercession of the Son of God. You are backed by the ministry of the Holy Spirit. You are backed by the covenant promises of Jehovah. The enemy knows that to get to you, he has to pass through Jesus first. To touch you, he has to get permission from the throne room of heaven. And even when permission is granted, like in the case of Job, it comes with limitations. The enemy can only go as far as God allows. He can only do what God permits. He can only operate within boundaries set by divine decree. Let me prophesy to someone. Every satanic agenda against your life, God is standing in the gap to frustrate it. Every demonic plot, every witchcraft manipulation, every occult attack, every evil pronouncement, every negative prophecy, God is standing in the gap to nullify it. The Bible says in Isaiah 54:17, "No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and every tongue which rises against you in judgment you shall condemn." But that scripture does not end there. It says, "This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is from me," says the Lord. Your righteousness, your protection, your vindication, it all comes from God. It is not because you are perfect. It is because you belong to him. It is because you are covered by his covenant. It is because he has chosen to stand in the gap for you. Now, let me show you the practical application of this revelation. When you understand that God stands in the gap for you, it changes how you pray. You stop praying like a beggar. You start praying like a son. You stop praying from a position of doubt. You start praying from a position of assurance. You stop praying with fear. You start praying with authority. Because you know that you are not alone in that prayer. You know that the Holy Spirit is joining his groanings with your groanings. You know that Jesus is adding his intercession to your petition. You know that the Father is listening because his son is speaking on your behalf. This is the confidence we have in him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us. And if we know that he hears us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we have asked of him. This is covenant confidence. This is what it means to pray in faith. Not faith in your eloquence. Not faith in your religiosity. Not faith in your fasting and praying. But faith in the one who stands in the gap for you. Faith in the finished work of Calvary. Faith in the blood that was shed for your redemption. Faith in the resurrection power that guarantees your victory. Some of you tonight, you need God to stand in the gap in your marriage. There is a crisis in your home. The enemy is trying to bring division. There is misunderstanding. There is strife. There is confusion. The love you once had seems to be fading. Communication has broken down, and you are afraid that your marriage might collapse. But I want you to know that God specializes in standing in the gap for marriages. The Bible says in Malachi 2:16, "For the Lord God of Israel says that he hates divorce." God is committed to the preservation of your marriage. God is committed to the restoration of your home. And when we invite God to stand in the gap, he will release the spirit of love. He will release the spirit of forgiveness. He will release the spirit of understanding. He will heal the wounds. He will mend the brokenness. He will restore what the enemy has stolen. For others, the gap is in your children. You are worried about your sons and daughters. They are going the wrong way. They are making wrong choices. They are in bad company. They are rebellious. They are disobedient. And you have prayed and prayed, but you are not seeing any change. I want to encourage you tonight. Don't give up on your children. The Bible says in Isaiah 49:25, "Thus says the Lord, 'Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible be delivered. For I will contend with him who contends with you, and I will save your children.'" Did you hear that? God said, "I will save your children." Not maybe. Not if they cooperate. Not if they are good enough. He said, "I will save your children." This is a divine promise. This is a covenant guarantee. When you pray, "God, stand in the gap for my children," you are activating angelic protection over their lives. You are releasing the ministry of the Holy Spirit to convict them of sin, righteousness, and judgment. You are invoking the mercy of God to overshadow their mistakes. You are declaring that they shall not die, but live to declare the works of the Lord. You are prophesying that the plan of God for their lives shall come to pass. You are decreeing that every satanic trap set for them shall be destroyed. You are commanding that every evil friend, every bad influence, every demonic association shall be separated from them by fire. Let me show you something else. When God stands in the gap for you, he doesn't just defend you. He also fights for you. There is a difference between defense and offense. Defense is about protection. Offense is about aggression against the enemy. The Bible says in Exodus 14:14, "The Lord will fight for you, and you shall hold your peace." This means that there are battles where your responsibility is not to fight, but to watch God fight. Your responsibility is not to strategize, but to stand still and see the salvation of the Lord. Your responsibility is not to panic, but to praise. Not to worry, but to worship. Not to fear, but to have faith. This is the revelation of spiritual warfare that many believers are missing. We are so busy trying to fight battles that God never asked us to fight. We are exhausting ourselves in warfare when God has already said, "Be still, and know that I am God." There is a warfare where your weapon is not prayer and fasting. Your weapon is worship. Your weapon is praise. Your weapon is thanksgiving. Your weapon is declaring the word of God. Because when you praise God in the midst of the battle, you are acknowledging that he is bigger than your problem. When you worship in the midst of warfare, you are enthrone God over your situation. And when God is enthroned, the enemy is dethroned. When God is lifted up, the enemy is cast down. Somebody needs to hear this. Stop fighting in your own strength. Stop trying to manipulate outcomes. Stop trying to control situations that are beyond your control. Release it to God. Let God stand in the gap. Let God do what only God can do. The Bible says in Psalm 46:10, "Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth." When you are still, when you rest in God, when you trust in his ability to stand in the gap for you, God is exalted. And when God is exalted, he demonstrates his power. He manifests his glory. He proves that he is indeed God. Now, let me take you to a very powerful scripture in the book of 2 Chronicles chapter 20. This is the story of King Jehoshaphat. Three armies came against Judah, the Moabites, the Ammonites, and the inhabitants of Mount Seir. The Bible says Jehoshaphat feared, and he set himself to seek the Lord. He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah. And in his prayer, he said something very powerful. He said, "Oh our God, will you not judge them? For we have no power against this great multitude that is coming against us. Nor do we know what to do, but our eyes are upon you." Do you see the humility? Do you see the dependence? Jehoshaphat was not trying to be a superhero. He was not pretending to have strength he didn't have. He was simply saying, "God, we are helpless without you. We don't know what to do, but we know who to look to. Our eyes are upon you." And how did God respond? The Bible says the Spirit of the Lord came upon Jahaziel, and he prophesied, "Thus says the Lord to you, 'Do not be afraid nor dismayed because of this great multitude, for the battle is not yours, but God's.'" Then he said something that should become your confession. He said, "You will not need to fight in this battle. Position yourselves, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, who is with you." The next day, Jehoshaphat appointed singers to go before the army, praising God. And as they began to sing and praise, the Lord set ambushes against the enemy, and they destroyed themselves. Judah did not lift a sword. Judah did not throw a spear. All they did was praise, and God stood in the gap and fought for them. This is what happens when you understand the power of letting God stand in the gap. Your battles become his battles. Your fights become his fights. Your challenges become his responsibility. And when God takes responsibility, victory is guaranteed. When God stands in the gap, defeat is impossible. When God fights for you, the enemy has no chance because our God is a man of war. Our God is the Lord of hosts. Our God is the commander of the armies of heaven. Our God is the one who drowned Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea. Our God is the one who brought down the walls of Jericho with a shout. Our God is the one who made the sun stand still in the days of Joshua. Our God is the one who shut the mouths of lions for Daniel. Our God is the one who brought David out of the wilderness and made him king. And that same God is standing in the gap for you tonight. Let me address a very important issue that some of you are facing. There are satanic altars speaking against your life. There are evil covenants that were made by your ancestors that are still active. There are shrines in your village where your name is mentioned every month. There are witchcraft covens where your photograph is being used for rituals. There are marine spirits that have been assigned to cage your destiny. There are familiar spirits monitoring your progress to report back to the kingdom of darkness. And you are wondering, "How do I fight an enemy I cannot see? How do I confront powers that are in the realm of the spirit?" The answer is this, you don't fight them alone. You ask God to stand in the gap. You invoke the fire of God to consume every satanic altar. You release the blood of Jesus to nullify every evil covenant. You command the angels of God to go into the kingdom of darkness and bring out everything that belongs to you. You decree that every witchcraft manipulation shall backfire. You prophesy that every marine cage shall be broken. You declare that every familiar spirit shall be disgraced. You proclaim that every ancestral stronghold shall be pulled down. And you do all of this not in your own name, not in your own power, not in your own authority, but in the name of Jesus Christ, the name above every other name, the name before which every knee must bow, the name at which demons tremble and hell shakes. When you proclaim the name of Jesus, you are not just mentioning a name. You are invoking a person. You are summoning the power of the resurrected Christ. You are activating the authority of the one to whom all power in heaven and on earth has been given. The Bible says in Philippians 2:9-11, "Therefore God also has highly exalted him and given him the name which is above every name, that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow of those in heaven and of those on earth and of those under the earth, and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord to the glory of God the Father." This means that when you use the name of Jesus, heaven responds, earth responds, and hell responds. Angels are dispatched, demons are displaced, and miracles are released. So, tonight as we are about to go into this prayer, I want you to understand that you are not praying as an orphan, you are not praying as someone who is alone. You are not praying as someone who has been abandoned. You are praying as a child of God, a joint heir with Christ, a member of the royal priesthood, a chosen generation, a peculiar treasure to God. And the God who owns heaven and earth, the God who created all things, the God who sustains all things by the word of his power, that God is standing in the gap for you. Now, let us pray with authority. Let us pray with faith. Let us pray with expectation, and let us watch God demonstrate his power on our behalf. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace tonight on behalf of every person reading this word, every person hearing this message, every person connected to this ministration. Lord, I thank you because you are the God who stands in the gap. You are the God who neither slumbers nor sleeps. You are the God who watches over your children day and night. And Father, we are asking you right now to stand in the gap for us and our households. Lord, where there is a breach in our finances, stand in the gap and close it by the blood of Jesus. Where there is a leak in our resources, stand in the gap and seal it by your power. Where the devourer has been stealing our substance, stand in the gap and rebuke the devourer for our sake. We decree that our income is blessed. Our businesses are blessed. Our investments are blessed. Our labor is blessed. We prophesy that promotion is coming. Opportunities are opening. Doors are swinging wide, and supernatural provision is being released in the name of Jesus. Father, where there is a gap in our health, stand in the gap and heal us. Every persistent sickness, every hereditary disease, every medical condition that has defied solutions, we command healing to come forth right now in the mighty name of Jesus. We release the healing virtue of God into every organ, every tissue, every cell, every system of the body. We decree that cancer is destroyed, tumors are dissolved, diabetes is reversed, high blood pressure is normalized, mental illness is broken, depression is lifted, anxiety is removed, and every form of sickness and disease is eradicated by the power of God. Lord, stand in the gap for our marriages. Where there is division, release unity. Where there is misunderstanding, release clarity. Where there is strife, release peace. Where love has grown cold, rekindle it by your spirit. We bind the spirit of divorce, the spirit of adultery, the spirit of unforgiveness, and the spirit of bitterness. We release the spirit of love, the spirit of understanding, the spirit of patience, and the spirit of commitment. We decree that our marriages are blessed, our homes are peaceful, and our families are united in Jesus' name. Father, stand in the gap for our children. Every child that has gone astray, bring them back. Every child that is in bad company, separate them by fire. Every child that is rebellious, soften their heart. Every child that is under demonic attack, deliver them now. We cover our children with the blood of Jesus. We release angelic protection over their lives. We decree that they shall not die, but live. They shall fulfill their destiny. They shall serve the Lord. They shall be mighty in the land. They shall be a blessing to their generation. And the plan of God for their lives shall come to pass in Jesus' name. Lord, we ask you to stand in the gap and break every generational curse operating in our bloodline. Every ancestral covenant, we nullify it by the blood of Jesus. Every evil pattern that has been repeating from generation to generation, we break it now. Every limitation that came from our forefathers, we destroy it tonight. Every demonic inheritance, we reject it and return it to the sender. We decree that the blessings of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob are our portion. We are the seed of Abraham, and we walk in covenant blessings. We are blessed in the city and blessed in the field. We are blessed when we come in and blessed when we go out. We are the head and not the tail. We are above only and not beneath. Father, stand in the gap and frustrate every satanic agenda against our lives. Every plan of the enemy, scatter it. Every plot of darkness, destroy it. Every strategy of hell, nullify it. We decree that no weapon formed against us shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against us in judgment, we condemn. Every evil pronouncement, we cancel. Every negative prophecy, we reverse. Every witchcraft manipulation, we destroy. Every marine attack, we terminate. Every ancestral spirit, we bind and cast out in the mighty name of Jesus. Lord, we ask you to stand in the gap for our destiny. Every cage, we break it. Every limitation, we destroy it. Every barrier, we remove it. Every delay, we cancel it. Every satanic embargo, we lift it. We decree that our time has come. Our season has arrived. Our breakthrough is here. Our miracle is now. Our testimony is imminent. We are stepping into our prophetic season. We are walking into our divine destiny. We are manifesting the glory of God, and nothing, absolutely nothing, shall stop us in Jesus' name. Father, for those who are facing legal battles, stand in the gap and give them victory. For those who are facing persecution, stand in the gap and vindicate them. For those who are facing false accusations, stand in the gap and defend them. For those who are facing injustice, stand in the gap and fight for them. We decree that every false witness shall be exposed. Every liar shall be disgraced. Every wicked judge shall be removed, and justice shall prevail in the mighty name of Jesus. Lord, we thank you because you are faithful. We thank you because you are true to your word. We thank you because you have never failed, and you will never fail. We thank you because you are standing in the gap for us even now. We receive our breakthrough. We receive our miracle. We receive our testimony, and we give you all the glory, all the honor, and all the praise in the matchless name of Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen and amen. Now, I want you to receive this word by faith. The prayer has been prayed. The decree has been made. The prophetic word has gone forth. And I want you to know that from this moment your life is taking a new turn. God has heard your cry. God has seen your situation. And God is standing in the gap for you. Your breakthrough is guaranteed. Your victory is assured. Your testimony is certain. Just keep believing. Keep trusting. Keep expecting, and keep thanking God in advance for what he's about to do. The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face shine upon you and be gracious unto you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
